facts.text: The hotel is set in West Hollywood's Design District.
facts.excerpt: is set in West Hollywood’s Design District

facts.text: L.A.-based Icelandic designer Gulla Jónsdóttir created the interiors.
facts.excerpt: L.A.-based Icelandic designer Gulla Jónsdóttir was enlisted to create the stylish interiors

facts.text: The interiors mix natural materials such as concrete, leather walls and white oak flooring.
facts.excerpt: a mix of natural materials (concrete, leather walls, white oak flooring)

facts.text: The lobby has custom six-foot light sconces.
facts.excerpt: custom furnishings, such as six-foot light sconces in the lobby

facts.text: The hotel has a feather chandelier.
facts.excerpt: From the sculptural walls to a dramatic feather chandelier

facts.text: Olive trees and a vertical garden make the pool feel secluded and intimate.
facts.excerpt: olive trees and a vertical garden make the pool feel secluded and intimate

facts.text: Ladyhawk, by Charbel Hayek, serves Eastern Mediterranean food with a Southern California twist.
facts.excerpt: The Eastern Med meets SoCal at Ladyhawk by Charbel Hayek

facts.text: No Rose is a cocktail bar at the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Step inside No Rose, a buzzy cocktail bar with a sense of intrigue.

facts.text: The hotel has a rooftop pickleball court.
facts.excerpt: Hollywood's rooftop paradise! Our Center Court boasts a state-of-the-art pickleball court

facts.text: Open-air yoga classes are hosted on the rooftop.
facts.excerpt: Open-air yoga classes are hosted on the rooftop

facts.text: There is no in-house spa; the hotel partners with the Ole Henriksen spa at nearby Sunset Plaza.
facts.excerpt: There’s no in-house spa, but the hotel has a partnership with the Ole Henriksen spa at the nearby Sunset Plaza.

facts.text: Pets of any size, weight or breed are welcome at no extra charge.
facts.excerpt: We invite you to bring your pet no matter their size, weight, or breed, all at no extra charge.

facts.text: Rooms have a complimentary mini bar and in-room bottle service for made-to-order craft cocktails.
facts.excerpt: There's also a complimentary mini bar and an in-room bottle service for made-to-order craft cocktails.

facts.text: The hotel is within walking distance of art galleries, coffee shops and restaurants.
facts.excerpt: within walking distance of art galleries, cool coffee shops, and some top-notch restaurants

facts.text: There is no complimentary local area shuttle.
facts.excerpt: No, there is not a complimentary local area shuttle available at Kimpton La Peer West Hollywood.

facts.text: Standard rooms are somewhat small but feel bright and airy.
facts.excerpt: Standard rooms are somewhat small but still manage to feel bright and airy
